nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; initialized to msg.sender in the Ownable constructor and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address proposed by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Roles.Role mapping of accounts holding the pauser privilege.
Boolean pause flag controlling the whenNotPaused / whenPaused modifiers.
Internal mapping of account balances.
Internal nested mapping of allowances (owner => spender => amount).
Total token supply, changed only by _mint and _burn.
Human readable token name.
Token symbol.
Token decimals (18 for ICB).
Address of the delegatecall implementation used by the ICB proxy fallback; written by upgradeTo/_setImplementation.
Mapping of address to dynamic array of LockInfo (releaseTime, amount) used for vesting locks.
Blacklist mapping checked by the notFrozen modifier.
Caller controlled address: owner/role initialization, access control checks and transfer sender.
Block timestamp (now) used to decide whether a timelock entry may be released.
Ownable constructor: sets owner = msg.sender and newOwner = address(0).
isOwner(address): view helper returning whether account == owner.
acceptOwnership(): onlyNewOwner; promotes newOwner to owner and clears the pending owner.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner; stores the pending new owner.
addPauser(address): onlyPauser; grants the pauser role to an account.
removePauser(address): onlyOwner; revokes the pauser role from an account.
renouncePauser(): removes msg.sender from the pauser role.
_addPauser(address): internal role-grant helper writing to _pausers.
isPauser(address): view role check used by the onlyPauser modifier.
_removePauser(address): internal role-revoke helper.
paused(): returns the _paused flag.
pause(): onlyPauser whenNotPaused; sets _paused to true.
unpause(): onlyPauser whenPaused; sets _paused to false.
ERC20.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf(address): returns _balances[owner].
ERC20.allowance(address,address): returns _allowed[owner][spender].
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256): moves the caller balance through _transfer.
ERC20.approve(address,uint256): overwrites the caller allowance for spender.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): SafeMath.sub on allowance then _transfer.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address,uint256): SafeMath.add on the caller allowance.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address,uint256): SafeMath.sub on the caller allowance.
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256): internal balance bookkeeping with SafeMath.
ERC20._mint(address,uint256): increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
ERC20._burn(address,uint256): decreases _totalSupply and holder balance.
ERC20._burnFrom(address,uint256): burns using the allowance of msg.sender.
ERC20Pausable.transfer: whenNotPaused wrapper that calls super.transfer.
ERC20Pausable.transferFrom: whenNotPaused wrapper that calls super.transferFrom.
ERC20Detailed constructor: stores name, symbol and decimals.
name(): returns _name.
symbol(): returns _symbol.
decimals(): returns _decimals.
ICB constructor: mints 30,000,000,000 * 10^18 tokens to msg.sender.
ICB.balanceOf(address): adds locked timelock amounts to the super balance in an unbounded loop.
ICB.transfer(address,uint256): notFrozen(msg.sender), auto-unlock then super.transfer.
ICB.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): notFrozen(from), auto-unlock then super.transferFrom.
freezeAccount(address): onlyPauser; blacklists a holder in frozenAccount.
unfreezeAccount(address): onlyPauser; removes a holder from the blacklist.
lock(address,uint256,uint256): onlyPauser; requires sufficient balance and locks funds.
transferWithLock(address,uint256,uint256): onlyPauser; _transfer then _lock for the holder.
unlock(address,uint256): onlyPauser; unlocks a timelock entry by index.
upgradeTo(address): onlyOwner; changes the proxy implementation address.
ICB._lock(address,uint256,uint256): subtracts balance and pushes a LockInfo entry.
ICB._unlock(address,uint256): swap-and-pop of a timelock entry and credit of the balance.
ICB._autoUnlock(address): loops timelockList and unlocks entries whose releaseTime <= now.
ICB._setImplementation(address): internal writer of the implementation slot.
Payable fallback: delegatecalls to implementation with raw calldata using inline assembly.
Unsafe delegatecall performed inside the payable fallback with attacker-supplied calldata.
Unbounded iteration over the user-growable timelockList array (gas/DoS risk).
Address parameter of freezeAccount/unfreezeAccount/lock/transferWithLock/unlock.
Amount parameter of lock / transferWithLock / _transfer.
Release timestamp parameter of lock / transferWithLock.
Index parameter of unlock.
New implementation address parameter of upgradeTo.
Storage pointer to the LockInfo entry being removed in _unlock.
Cached lock amount credited back to the holder in _unlock.
Pending owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Account parameter of addPauser / _addPauser.
Accumulator combining unlocked and locked balances in ICB.balanceOf.
Recipient parameter of _transfer and the transfer wrappers.
Source parameter of _transfer and transferFrom.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor reads the caller address to initialize owner, making msg.sender the first privileged account.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
acceptOwnership writes owner from the pending newOwner under the onlyNewOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) writes the pending newOwner slot.
onlyOwner modifier validates msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership runs.
onlyNewOwner modifier validates msg.sender against newOwner before acceptOwnership runs.
addPauser delegates the role grant to the internal _addPauser helper.
onlyPauser modifier checks isPauser(msg.sender) || isOwner(msg.sender) on addPauser.
_addPauser sets the bearer flag in the _pausers role mapping.
isPauser reads the _pausers role mapping.
removePauser delegates the revocation to _removePauser.
renouncePauser revokes the role of msg.sender through _removePauser.
renouncePauser acts on msg.sender, letting any pauser drop its own privilege.
_removePauser clears the bearer flag in the _pausers role mapping.
pause writes _paused = true.
unpause writes _paused = false.
pause is guarded by onlyPauser which inspects msg.sender.
unpause is guarded by onlyPauser which inspects msg.sender.
whenNotPaused modifier requires !_paused before pause executes.
whenPaused modifier requires _paused before unpause executes.
whenNotPaused on ERC20Pausable.transfer gates all transfers on _paused.
whenNotPaused on ERC20Pausable.transferFrom gates delegated transfers on _paused.
ICB.transfer inherits the whenNotPaused gate from the ERC20Pausable implementation.
ERC20Pausable.transfer calls super.transfer.
ERC20Pausable.transferFrom calls super.transferFrom.
ERC20.transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer forwards to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the _allowed allowance before moving funds.
transferFrom uses the caller msg.sender as the spender of the allowance.
transferFrom calls _transfer after spending the allowance.
approve writes the _allowed mapping for msg.sender/spender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance writes the _allowed mapping using SafeMath.add.
decreaseAllowance writes the _allowed mapping using SafeMath.sub.
_mint credits the recipient in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn debits the holder in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burnFrom spends the allowance stored in _allowed.
_burnFrom calls _burn for the actual supply reduction.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores the token name.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores the token symbol.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores the decimals value.
name() reads _name.
symbol() reads _symbol.
decimals() reads _decimals.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf reads _balances.
allowance() reads _allowed.
ICB constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
ICB constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
ICB.balanceOf starts from the super balance in _balances.
ICB.balanceOf sums the locked amounts stored in timelockList.
The balanceOf loop over timelockList can grow without bound for a locked holder.
notFrozen(msg.sender) modifier blocks blacklisted senders from transferring.
ICB.transfer calls _autoUnlock before moving funds.
ICB.transfer calls super.transfer (ERC20Pausable) after auto unlock.
notFrozen(from) modifier blocks blacklisted sources from being transferred.
ICB.transferFrom triggers _autoUnlock for the source account.
ICB.transferFrom calls super.transferFrom (ERC20Pausable).
freezeAccount (onlyPauser) writes frozenAccount[holder] = true.
unfreezeAccount (onlyPauser) writes frozenAccount[holder] = false.
freezeAccount is restricted to the pauser role resolved from msg.sender.
unfreezeAccount is restricted to the pauser role resolved from msg.sender.
lock is restricted to the pauser role resolved from msg.sender.
transferWithLock is restricted to the pauser role resolved from msg.sender.
unlock is restricted to the pauser role resolved from msg.sender.
lock requires _balances[holder] >= value before locking.
lock defers the balance and timelock mutation to _lock.
transferWithLock moves tokens to the holder with _transfer before locking.
transferWithLock then records the lock through _lock.
unlock delegates the array mutation to _unlock.
_lock subtracts the locked amount from _balances.
_lock pushes a LockInfo entry into timelockList.
_unlock deletes and swap-pops entries of timelockList.
_unlock credits the released amount back into _balances.
_autoUnlock calls _unlock for every expired lock of the holder.
_autoUnlock iterates and shrinks timelockList while unlocking.
_autoUnlock compares releaseTime with now, making release conditional on the miner-controlled block.timestamp.
_autoUnlock loops over an attacker-growable timelockList array, an unbounded gas sink.
upgradeTo forwards the new address to _setImplementation.
onlyOwner modifier restricts implementation upgrades to the owner.
onlyOwner validates msg.sender == owner before upgradeTo executes.
_setImplementation writes the implementation storage slot.
The fallback loads the implementation address before delegatecalling.
The fallback forwards arbitrary caller calldata into implementation via delegatecall, exposing the proxy state to the external code.
The delegatecall executes the code located at the owner-updatable implementation address.
holder parameter is consumed by lock.
holder parameter is consumed by transferWithLock.
holder parameter is consumed by unlock.
holder parameter is consumed by freezeAccount.
holder parameter is consumed by unfreezeAccount.
value parameter is consumed by lock.
value parameter is consumed by transferWithLock.
releaseTime parameter is consumed by lock.
releaseTime parameter is consumed by transferWithLock.
idx parameter selects the timelock entry removed by unlock.
_newImplementation parameter is consumed by upgradeTo.
lockinfo storage pointer is read while removing the timelock entry in _unlock.
releaseAmount is the cached amount refunded by _unlock.
_newOwner parameter is stored by transferOwnership.
spender parameter indexes the _allowed mapping in approve.
account parameter is granted the pauser role by addPauser.
totalBalance accumulates the unlocked and locked amounts in ICB.balanceOf.
to parameter is the credited account in _transfer.
from parameter is the debited account in _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: holder is a plain address argument that only flows into the pauser-gated lock/transferWithLock state mutations.
value is an intermediate amount that only feeds the internal _lock balance and LockInfo update.
releaseTime is stored directly into the LockInfo struct created inside _lock.
idx is an intermediate array index used exclusively by the internal _unlock swap-and-pop.
_newImplementation is just forwarded to the internal implementation-slot writer.
lockinfo is a transient storage pointer created and consumed inside _unlock.
releaseAmount is a local cache of the unlocked amount used only inside _unlock.
_newOwner is an intermediate address stored only by the transferOwnership setter.
spender is an intermediate address used only as the allowance key inside approve.
account is an intermediate address granted the role through the addPauser wrapper.
totalBalance is a temporary accumulator that exists only within the balanceOf computation.
to is an intermediate recipient argument consumed by the internal _transfer routine.
from is an intermediate source argument consumed by the internal _transfer routine.
